Main Investigative Directorate

Every piece of evidence matters.

The Main Investigative Directorate handles complex criminal investigations, evidence review and coordination of investigative activities. Objectivity is its guiding principle.

Every case requires careful examination, consistent evidence review and teamwork. The investigative directorate takes a structured approach to preparing cases.

Area of work

Primary responsibilities

  • Investigation of serious crimes
  • Collection and review of evidence
  • Preparation of case documentation
  • Coordination between divisions
